name: cache-palace
description: Keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks, stops a cold send once with its rewrite price, and opens a pane showing the cache's state, pings and cold writes. A modified copy of cache-tax by Karan Bansal. Warming uses model requests and costs tokens. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+.

author.name: leonwcl95 (based on cache-tax by Karan Bansal)
